reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x004102D0 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/define/004102D0-DefineHumanPlayerAmmoLimit.cpp at sha256 7162f2bb7e5db8be94ed5af3f83a572b5256bcd7d07e52779708fe2759d4cc21 (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t DefineHumanPlayerAmmoLimit(int32_t param_1, int32_t* param_2);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.
